name: cobol-source-directive-whole-file
body: directive takes the first >>SOURCE line and applies its format to the whole file; FIXED, FREE and COBOL85 are implemented, while VARIABLE, XOPEN, XCARD, CRT, TERMINAL and COBOLX are diagnosed and read with the dialect default. Limit: a mid-file format switch and the six other formats are not honoured. Upgrade when a corpus needs a mid-file directive or one of those formats.
